docs.title: action
docs.text: action · string · Yes · A string specifying the implicit action being requested to be performed

docs.title: data
docs.text: data · object · No · An optional object that contains data to be used by the application in order to fulfil the action

docs.title: context
docs.text: context · object · Yes · An object defining the source of the intent and optionally properties of that source

docs.title: Method
docs.text: Method · Method call with no parameters · Params is not provided

docs.title: Method
docs.text: Method · Method call with one or more parameters · Params is an object. Arrays are not used

docs.title: Response
docs.text: Response · Success with no return value

docs.title: Response
docs.text: Response · Success returning a single primitive value · result is a primitive type

docs.title: Response
docs.text: Response · Success returning a single attribute that is an array of values of the same primitive type

docs.title: Response
docs.text: Response · Success returning more than one value

docs.title: Method
docs.text: Method · Notification of a primitive type · The params object has a single member that is always called "value"

docs.title: Method
docs.text: Method · Notification of a single attribute that is an array of values of the same primitive type · Params is an array that represents one attribute, not positional parameters in this case C++ example: void onSomething( std::vector<std::string> bar )

docs.title: Method
docs.text: Method · Notification of an object · params contains all the attributes of the object

docs.title: Method
docs.text: Method · Notification of a list of objects · Params is an array that represents one attribute, not positional parameters in this case. Rarely used
